description: Open the FreeCAD file '~/Documents/FreeCAD/contact_blocks.FCStd'. This file contains two shapes: 'TopBox' and 'BottomBox'. Apply a 2mm chamfer to ALL 12 edges of the 'TopBox' shape. You can use the Part Workbench (Part > Chamfer) to do this. Keep the BottomBox unmodified. Save the resulting FreeCAD document as '~/Documents/FreeCAD/chamfered_blocks.FCStd'. Finally, select the chamfered TopBox and export it to STEP format at '~/Documents/FreeCAD/chamfered_topbox.step'.
